===== FILE: recorder/src/App.tsx =====
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { FolderOpen, Mic, Monitor } from 'lucide-react';
import { AppLang, DeviceCapabilities, RecorderTab, SavedRecording } from './types';
import { HeaderBar } from './components/HeaderBar';
import { VoiceRecorderView } from './components/VoiceRecorderView';
import { ScreenRecorderView } from './components/ScreenRecorderView';
import { LibraryView } from './components/LibraryView';
import { AboutModal } from './components/AboutModal';
import { detectDeviceCapabilities } from './utils/screenCapabilities';
import { deleteRecordingItem, getAllRecordings, saveRecordingItem } from './utils/mediaDb';

const STORAGE_LANG_KEY = 'studio_rec_lang_v1';

export function App() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<RecorderTab>('voice');
  const [lang, setLang] = useState<AppLang>(() => {
    try {
      const v = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_LANG_KEY);
      return v === 'ar' || v === 'en' || v === 'fr' ? v : 'fr';
    } catch {
      return 'fr';
    }
  });
  const [capabilities, setCapabilities] = useState<DeviceCapabilities | null>(null);
  const [recordings, setRecordings] = useState<SavedRecording[]>([]);
  const [isVoiceRecording, setIsVoiceRecording] = useState(false);
  const [isScreenRecording, setIsScreenRecording] = useState(false);
  const [showAbout, setShowAbout] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_LANG_KEY, lang);
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
  }, [lang]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void detectDeviceCapabilities().then(setCapabilities);
    void getAllRecordings().then(setRecordings).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const handleSaveRecording = async (rec: SavedRecording) => {
    await saveRecordingItem(rec);
    const updated = await getAllRecordings();
    setRecordings(updated);
  };

  const handleDeleteRecording = async (id: string) => {
    await deleteRecordingItem(id);
    setRecordings((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.id !== id));
  };

  const navItems: { id: RecorderTab; label: Record<AppLang, string>; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [
    {
      id: 'voice',
      label: { fr: 'Voix MP3', ar: 'صوت MP3', en: 'Voice MP3' },
      icon: <Mic className="w-5 h-5" />,
    },
    {
      id: 'screen',
      label: { fr: 'Écran 4K', ar: 'شاشة 4K', en: 'Screen 4K' },
      icon: <Monitor className="w-5 h-5" />,
    },
    {
      id: 'library',
      label: {
        fr: `Fichiers (${recordings.length})`,
        ar: `الملفات (${recordings.length})`,
        en: `Vault (${recordings.length})`,
      },
      icon: <FolderOpen className="w-5 h-5" />,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div
      dir={lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
      className="h-[100dvh] w-full flex flex-col bg-[#0a0a0a] text-[#f5f5f5] overflow-hidden"
    >
      <HeaderBar
        activeTab={activeTab}
        lang={lang}
        isVoiceRecording={isVoiceRecording}
        isScreenRecording={isScreenRecording}
        onChangeLang={setLang}
        onJumpToTab={setActiveTab}
        onOpenAbout={() => setShowAbout(true)}
      />

      {/* Keep Voice & Screen tabs mounted with hidden toggle while recording so tab switching never kills active streams */}
      <main className="flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        <div className={activeTab === 'voice' ? 'flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden' : 'hidden'}>
          <VoiceRecorderView
            lang={lang}
            onRecordingStateChange={setIsVoiceRecording}
            onSaveRecording={handleSaveRecording}
            onGoToLibrary={() => setActiveTab('library')}
          />
        </div>

        <div className={activeTab === 'screen' ? 'flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden' : 'hidden'}>
          <ScreenRecorderView
            lang={lang}
            capabilities={capabilities}
            onRecordingStateChange={setIsScreenRecording}
            onSaveRecording={handleSaveRecording}
            onGoToLibrary={() => setActiveTab('library')}
          />
        </div>

        {activeTab === 'library' && (
          <LibraryView
            lang={lang}
            recordings={recordings}
            onDelete={handleDeleteRecording}
            onSaveConverted={handleSaveRecording}
          />
        )}
      </main>

      {/* Bottom 3-Tab Thumb-Zone Nav Bar */}
      <nav className="shrink-0 bg-[#0f0f0f] border-t border-[#222222] px-3 py-2 pb-[max(0.5rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
        <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          {navItems.map((item) => {
            const active = activeTab === item.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={item.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(item.id)}
                className={`min-h-[52px] rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                  active
                    ? 'bg-[#d4af37] text-stone-950 font-extrabold shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/15'
                    : 'text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-200 hover:bg-[#171717] font-medium'
                }`}
              >
                {item.icon}
                <span className="text-[11px] leading-none">{item.label[lang]}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </nav>

      <AboutModal isOpen={showAbout} onClose={() => setShowAbout(false)} lang={lang} />
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

===== FILE: recorder/src/types.ts =====
export type RecorderTab = 'voice' | 'screen' | 'library';

export type AppLang = 'fr' | 'ar' | 'en';

export type AudioFormatId = 'mp3_320' | 'mp3_192' | 'mp3_128' | 'mp3_64' | 'wav_pcm';

export interface AudioFormatPreset {
  id: AudioFormatId;
  title: string;
  subtitle: Record<AppLang, string>;
  kbps: number;
  sampleRate: number;
  channels: 1 | 2;
  ext: 'mp3' | 'wav';
  mimeType: string;
}

export type ScreenResolutionId = '4k_2160p' | '2k_1440p' | 'fhd_1080p' | 'hd_720p';

export interface ScreenPreset {
  id: ScreenResolutionId;
  label: string;
  shortLabel: string;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  bitrateMbps: number;
  defaultFps: 30 | 60;
}

export interface ScreenTierSupport {
  id: ScreenResolutionId;
  capable: boolean;
  recommended: boolean;
  reason: Record<AppLang, string>;
}

export interface DeviceCapabilities {
  physicalLongEdge: number;
  physicalShortEdge: number;
  devicePixelRatio: number;
  supportsDisplayCapture: boolean;
  supportsAudioCapture: boolean;
  supportsWebCodecs: boolean;
  supportedMimeTypes: string[];
  bestMimeType: string;
  tiers: Record<ScreenResolutionId, ScreenTierSupport>;
  recommendedResolution: ScreenResolutionId;
}

export interface SavedRecording {
  id: string;
  kind: 'audio' | 'video';
  title: string;
  formatLabel: string;
  fileExt: string;
  mimeType: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
  durationMs: number;
  createdAt: number;
  resolutionLabel?: string;
  fps?: number;
  bitrateLabel?: string;
  peaks?: number[];
  blob: Blob;
}

===== FILE: recorder/src/components/HeaderBar.tsx =====
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Download, Info } from 'lucide-react';
import { AppLang, RecorderTab } from '../types';

interface BeforeInstallPromptEvent extends Event {
  prompt: () => Promise<void>;
  userChoice: Promise<{ outcome: 'accepted' | 'dismissed' }>;
}

interface HeaderBarProps {
  activeTab: RecorderTab;
  lang: AppLang;
  isVoiceRecording: boolean;
  isScreenRecording: boolean;
  onChangeLang: (lang: AppLang) => void;
  onJumpToTab: (tab: RecorderTab) => void;
  onOpenAbout: () => void;
}

const TAB_TITLES: Record<RecorderTab, Record<AppLang, string>> = {
  voice: { fr: 'Studio Voix MP3', ar: 'مسجل الصوت MP3', en: 'Voice Studio MP3' },
  screen: { fr: 'Capture Écran 4K', ar: 'تصوير الشاشة 4K', en: '4K Screen Studio' },
  library: { fr: 'Mes Enregistrements', ar: 'مكتبة التسجيلات', en: 'Media Vault' },
};

export const HeaderBar: React.FC<HeaderBarProps> = ({
  activeTab,
  lang,
  isVoiceRecording,
  isScreenRecording,
  onChangeLang,
  onJumpToTab,
  onOpenAbout,
}) => {
  const [installPrompt, setInstallPrompt] = useState<BeforeInstallPromptEvent | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: Event) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setInstallPrompt(e as BeforeInstallPromptEvent);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handler);
  }, []);

  const handleInstall = async () => {
    if (!installPrompt) return;
    await installPrompt.prompt();
    const { outcome } = await installPrompt.userChoice;
    if (outcome === 'accepted') {
      setInstallPrompt(null);
    }
  };

  const cycleLang = () => {
    const next: Record<AppLang, AppLang> = { fr: 'ar', ar: 'en', en: 'fr' };
    onChangeLang(next[lang]);
  };

  return (
    <header className="shrink-0 bg-[#0f0f0f] border-b border-[#222222] px-4 py-2.5 pt-[max(0.625rem,env(safe-area-inset-top))]">
      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
          <img
            src="/icon.svg"
            alt="Studio Rec"
            className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl border border-[#d4af37]/40 shadow-md shrink-0"
          />
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h1 className="font-display font-extrabold text-base text-white tracking-tight truncate">
              {TAB_TITLES[activeTab][lang]}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-[#d4af37] truncate">
              Studio Rec · Aymen Gharsalli
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
          {isVoiceRecording && activeTab !== 'voice' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onJumpToTab('voice')}
              className="min-h-[40px] px-2.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/20 border border-rose-500/60 text-rose-300 text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 animate-pulse" />
              <span>REC</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {isScreenRecording && activeTab !== 'screen' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onJumpToTab('screen')}
              className="min-h-[40px] px-2.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/20 border border-rose-500/60 text-rose-300 text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 animate-pulse" />
              <span>4K REC</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {installPrompt && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleInstall}
              aria-label="Install app"
              className="min-h-[40px] px-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#d4af37] hover:bg-[#e5c158] text-stone-950 text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">PWA</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={cycleLang}
            className="min-w-[42px] min-h-[40px] px-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#181818] hover:bg-[#222222] border border-[#2c2c2c] text-xs font-bold text-[#d4af37] uppercase cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            {lang}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onOpenAbout}
            aria-label="About"
            className="min-w-[40px] min-h-[40px] rounded-xl bg-[#181818] hover:bg-[#222222] border border-[#2c2c2c] text-stone-300 hover:text-[#d4af37] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Info className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
};

===== FILE: recorder/src/components/VoiceRecorderView.tsx =====
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, Mic, Pause, Play, Sliders, Square } from 'lucide-react';
import { AppLang, AudioFormatId, SavedRecording } from '../types';
import { AUDIO_FORMAT_PRESETS, encodeAudioBlobToPreset } from '../utils/audioEncoder';

interface VoiceRecorderViewProps {
  lang: AppLang;
  onRecordingStateChange: (recording: boolean) => void;
  onSaveRecording: (rec: SavedRecording) => Promise<void>;
  onGoToLibrary: () => void;
}

function formatTimerMs(ms: number): string {
  const centis = Math.floor((ms % 1000) / 10);
  const totalSec = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const secs = totalSec % 60;
  const mins = Math.floor(totalSec / 60) % 60;
  const hrs = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
  if (hrs > 0) {
    return `${String(hrs).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}.${String(centis).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  return `${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}.${String(centis).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export const VoiceRecorderView: React.FC<VoiceRecorderViewProps> = ({
  lang,
  onRecordingStateChange,
  onSaveRecording,
  onGoToLibrary,
}) => {
  const [selectedFormatId, setSelectedFormatId] = useState<AudioFormatId>('mp3_320');
  const [noiseSuppression, setNoiseSuppression] = useState(true);
  const [echoCancellation, setEchoCancellation] = useState(true);
  const [autoGainControl, setAutoGainControl] = useState(true);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'recording' | 'paused' | 'encoding'>('idle');
  const [elapsedMs, setElapsedMs] = useState(0);
  const [encodeProgress, setEncodeProgress] = useState(0);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [savedToast, setSavedToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const audioCtxRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const analyserRef = useRef<AnalyserNode | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);
  const accumMsRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const startAtRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const timerRafRef = useRef<number>(0);

  const selectedPreset =
    AUDIO_FORMAT_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === selectedFormatId) || AUDIO_FORMAT_PRESETS[0];

  const stopTracksAndAudio = () => {
    if (timerRafRef.current) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(timerRafRef.current);
      timerRafRef.current = 0;
    }
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    streamRef.current = null;
    audioCtxRef.current?.close().catch(() => {});
    audioCtxRef.current = null;
    analyserRef.current = null;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      stopTracksAndAudio();
    };
  }, []);

  // Draw live spectrum / waveform canvas
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    let raf = 0;
    const draw = () => {
      const w = canvas.width;
      const h = canvas.height;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

      // Subtle center baseline
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.16)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, h / 2);
      ctx.lineTo(w, h / 2);
      ctx.stroke();

      const analyser = analyserRef.current;
      const barCount = 48;
      const gap = 4;
      const barWidth = (w - gap * (barCount - 1)) / barCount;

      if (analyser && (status === 'recording' || status === 'paused')) {
        const freqData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
        analyser.getByteFrequencyData(freqData);
        const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(freqData.length / barCount));

        for (let i = 0; i < barCount; i++) {
          const val = status === 'paused' ? 0.08 : Math.max(0.06, freqData[i * step] / 255);
          const barH = val * (h - 14);
          const x = i * (barWidth + gap);
          const y = (h - barH) / 2;

          const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, y + barH);
          grad.addColorStop(0, '#fff1c1');
          grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#d4af37');
          grad.addColorStop(1, '#8b6508');
          ctx.fillStyle = grad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(x, y, barWidth, barH, 3);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      } else {
        for (let i = 0; i < barCount; i++) {
          const idleH = 8 + Math.sin(i * 0.45) * 4;
          const x = i * (barWidth + gap);
          const y = (h - idleH) / 2;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(x, y, barWidth, idleH, 3);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }

      if (status === 'recording') {
        setElapsedMs(accumMsRef.current + (performance.now() - startAtRef.current));
      }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    };

    raf = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [status]);

  const handleStart = async () => {
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setSavedToast(null);
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      setErrorMsg(
        lang === 'ar'
          ? 'الميكروفون غير مدعوم على هذا المتصفح.'
          : lang === 'en'
            ? 'Microphone capture is unavailable on this device.'
            : 'Capture microphone indisponible sur cet appareil.'
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        audio: {
          noiseSuppression,
          echoCancellation,
          autoGainControl,
          channelCount: selectedPreset.channels,
          sampleRate: selectedPreset.sampleRate,
        },
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;

      const AudioCtx =
        window.AudioContext ||
        (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
      if (AudioCtx) {
        const aCtx = new AudioCtx();
        const source = aCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
        const analyser = aCtx.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = 256;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.78;
        source.connect(analyser);
        audioCtxRef.current = aCtx;
        analyserRef.current = analyser;
      }

      const preferredMimes = ['audio/webm;codecs=opus', 'audio/webm', 'audio/mp4'];
      const mimeType = preferredMimes.find((m) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m)) || '';
      const recorder = mimeType ? new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType }) : new MediaRecorder(stream);

      chunksRef.current = [];
      recorder.ondataavailable = (ev) => {
        if (ev.data && ev.data.size > 0) {
          chunksRef.current.push(ev.data);
        }
      };

      mediaRecorderRef.current = recorder;
      recorder.start(250);
      accumMsRef.current = 0;
      startAtRef.current = performance.now();
      setElapsedMs(0);
      setStatus('recording');
      onRecordingStateChange(true);
    } catch {
      stopTracksAndAudio();
      setErrorMsg(
        lang === 'ar'
          ? 'تم رفض إذن الميكروفون. فعّله من إعدادات التطبيق.'
          : lang === 'en'
            ? 'Microphone permission denied. Please allow access.'
            : 'Autorisation microphone refusée. Veuillez autoriser l’accès.'
      );
    }
  };

  const handlePauseResume = () => {
    const rec = mediaRecorderRef.current;
    if (!rec) return;

    if (status === 'recording') {
      accumMsRef.current += performance.now() - startAtRef.current;
      rec.pause();
      setStatus('paused');
    } else if (status === 'paused') {
      startAtRef.current = performance.now();
      rec.resume();
      setStatus('recording');
    }
  };

  const handleStopAndEncode = () => {
    const rec = mediaRecorderRef.current;
    if (!rec) return;

    const finalElapsed =
      status === 'recording' ? accumMsRef.current + (performance.now() - startAtRef.current) : accumMsRef.current;

    setStatus('encoding');
    setEncodeProgress(10);
    onRecordingStateChange(false);

    rec.onstop = async () => {
      stopTracksAndAudio();
      const rawBlob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: rec.mimeType || 'audio/webm' });

      try {
        const { blob, durationMs, peaks } = await encodeAudioBlobToPreset(
          rawBlob,
          selectedPreset,
          (pct) => setEncodeProgress(pct)
        );
        const now = new Date();
        const stamp = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
        const saved: SavedRecording = {
          id: `aud-${Date.now()}`,
          kind: 'audio',
          title:
            lang === 'ar'
              ? `تسجيل صوتي ${stamp}`
              : lang === 'en'
                ? `Voice Note ${stamp}`
                : `Mémo Vocal ${stamp}`,
          formatLabel: selectedPreset.title,
          fileExt: selectedPreset.ext,
          mimeType: selectedPreset.mimeType,
          sizeBytes: blob.size,
          durationMs: durationMs || Math.round(finalElapsed),
          createdAt: Date.now(),
          bitrateLabel: `${selectedPreset.kbps} kbps`,
          peaks,
          blob,
        };
        await onSaveRecording(saved);
        setSavedToast(`${saved.title}.${saved.fileExt}`);
      } catch {
        setErrorMsg(
          lang === 'ar'
            ? 'حدث خطأ أثناء تحويل الصوت إلى MP3.'
            : lang === 'en'
              ? 'Failed to encode recording to MP3.'
              : 'Erreur lors de l’encodage MP3.'
        );
      } finally {
        setStatus('idle');
        setEncodeProgress(0);
        setElapsedMs(0);
      }
    };

    rec.stop();
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-4 max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full space-y-5">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 items-start">
        {/* Main Studio Console */}
        <section className="lg:col-span-7 rounded-3xl border border-[#2a2416] bg-gradient-to-b from-[#17140d] to-[#0d0d0d] p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#d4af37]">
              <Mic className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{selectedPreset.title}</span>
              <span className="text-stone-500">·</span>
              <span className="text-stone-300">{selectedPreset.channels === 2 ? 'Stereo' : 'Mono'}</span>
            </div>
            {status === 'recording' && (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-rose-400">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 animate-pulse" />
                REC
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Digital Chronometer */}
          <div className="text-center py-2">
            <p className="font-mono font-black text-5xl sm:text-6xl text-white tracking-tight tabular-nums">
              {formatTimerMs(elapsedMs)}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Live 48-Band Gold Spectrum Canvas */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#090909] border border-[#242016] p-3">
            <canvas ref={canvasRef} width={560} height={110} className="w-full h-28 block" />
          </div>

          {/* MP3 Encoding Progress */}
          {status === 'encoding' && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-bold text-[#f3e5ab]">
                <span>
                  {lang === 'ar'
                    ? `جاري الترميز إلى ${selectedPreset.title}...`
                    : lang === 'en'
                      ? `Encoding ${selectedPreset.title}...`
                      : `Encodage ${selectedPreset.title}...`}
                </span>
                <span className="font-mono">{encodeProgress}%</span>
              </div>
              <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-[#1e1e1e] overflow-hidden">
                <div
                  className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#aa8010] to-[#fff1c1] transition-all"
                  style={{ width: `${encodeProgress}%` }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Error or Saved Toast */}
          {errorMsg && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/35 text-xs text-rose-300">
              {errorMsg}
            </div>
          )}

          {savedToast && status === 'idle' && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#18160d] border border-[#d4af37]/40 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#f3e5ab] truncate">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37] shrink-0" />
                <span className="truncate">
                  {lang === 'ar' ? `تم الحفظ: ${savedToast}` : lang === 'en' ? `Saved: ${savedToast}` : `Enregistré : ${savedToast}`}
                </span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onGoToLibrary}
                className="font-bold text-[#d4af37] hover:underline shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {lang === 'ar' ? 'فتح المكتبة' : lang === 'en' ? 'Open Vault' : 'Ouvrir'}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Primary Action Controls */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-1">
            {status === 'idle' ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleStart}
                className="w-full min-h-[56px] rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#d4af37] to-[#aa8010] hover:from-[#e5c158] hover:to-[#be9012] text-stone-950 text-base font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Mic className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span>
                  {lang === 'ar' ? 'بدء التسجيل الصوتي' : lang === 'en' ? 'Start Voice Recording' : 'Démarrer l’Enregistrement'}
                </span>
              </button>
            ) : (
              <>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handlePauseResume}
                  disabled={status === 'encoding'}
                  className="flex-1 min-h-[54px] rounded-2xl bg-[#1a1a1a] hover:bg-[#252525] border border-[#303030] text-white text-sm font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
                >
                  {status === 'paused' ? <Play className="w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37]" /> : <Pause className="w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37]" />}
                  <span>
                    {status === 'paused'
                      ? lang === 'ar' ? 'استمرار' : lang === 'en' ? 'Resume' : 'Reprendre'
                      : lang === 'ar' ? 'إيقاف مؤقت' : lang === 'en' ? 'Pause' : 'Pause'}
                  </span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleStopAndEncode}
                  disabled={status === 'encoding'}
                  className="flex-1 min-h-[54px] rounded-2xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white text-sm font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
                >
                  <Square className="w-4 h-4 fill-current" />
                  <span>
                    {lang === 'ar' ? 'إنهاء وحفظ MP3' : lang === 'en' ? 'Stop & Save' : 'Arrêter & Sauver'}
                  </span>
                </button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Right Column: Multiple MP3 Format & DSP Controls */}
        <section className="lg:col-span-5 rounded-3xl border border-[#242424] bg-[#121212] p-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37]" />
            <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-white">
              {lang === 'ar' ? 'صيغ MP3 وجودة الصوت' : lang === 'en' ? 'MP3 Bitrates & Format' : 'Formats MP3 & Qualité Audio'}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            {AUDIO_FORMAT_PRESETS.map((preset) => {
              const active = selectedFormatId === preset.id;
              const disabled = status !== 'idle';
              const mbPerMin = ((preset.kbps * 60) / 8 / 1000).toFixed(1);
              return (
                <button
                  key={preset.id}
                  type="button"
                  disabled={disabled}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedFormatId(preset.id)}
                  className={`w-full min-h-[54px] px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl border flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-60 ${
                    active
                      ? 'bg-[#1a160c] border-[#d4af37] text-white'
                      : 'bg-[#161616] border-[#252525] text-stone-300 hover:border-[#383838]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div>
                    <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${active ? 'text-[#d4af37]' : 'text-white'}`}>
                      {preset.title}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-400">{preset.subtitle[lang]}</p>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono text-stone-400 shrink-0 tabular-nums">
                    ~{mbPerMin} MB/m
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* DSP Mic Processing Toggles */}
          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-[#222222] space-y-2 text-xs">
            <p className="font-bold text-stone-300">
              {lang === 'ar' ? 'معالجة الميكروفون' : lang === 'en' ? 'Microphone DSP' : 'Traitement Micro'}
            </p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={status !== 'idle'}
                onClick={() => setNoiseSuppression((v) => !v)}
                className={`min-h-[42px] px-2 rounded-xl border font-semibold cursor-pointer ${
                  noiseSuppression
                    ? 'bg-[#1a160c] border-[#d4af37]/60 text-[#f3e5ab]'
                    : 'bg-[#161616] border-[#262626] text-stone-400'
                }`}
              >
                {lang === 'ar' ? 'عزل الضجيج' : lang === 'en' ? 'Denoise' : 'Anti-bruit'}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={status !== 'idle'}
                onClick={() => setEchoCancellation((v) => !v)}
                className={`min-h-[42px] px-2 rounded-xl border font-semibold cursor-pointer ${
                  echoCancellation
                    ? 'bg-[#1a160c] border-[#d4af37]/60 text-[#f3e5ab]'
                    : 'bg-[#161616] border-[#262626] text-stone-400'
                }`}
              >
                {lang === 'ar' ? 'منع الصدى' : lang === 'en' ? 'No Echo' : 'Anti-écho'}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={status !== 'idle'}
                onClick={() => setAutoGainControl((v) => !v)}
                className={`min-h-[42px] px-2 rounded-xl border font-semibold cursor-pointer ${
                  autoGainControl
                    ? 'bg-[#1a160c] border-[#d4af37]/60 text-[#f3e5ab]'
                    : 'bg-[#161616] border-[#262626] text-stone-400'
                }`}
              >
                {lang === 'ar' ? 'توازن الصوت' : lang === 'en' ? 'Auto Gain' : 'Gain Auto'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

===== FILE: recorder/src/components/ScreenRecorderView.tsx =====
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  Cpu,
  Monitor,
  Pause,
  Play,
  Square,
  Video,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  AppLang,
  DeviceCapabilities,
  SavedRecording,
  ScreenResolutionId,
} from '../types';
import { SCREEN_PRESETS } from '../utils/screenCapabilities';

interface ScreenRecorderViewProps {
  lang: AppLang;
  capabilities: DeviceCapabilities | null;
  onRecordingStateChange: (recording: boolean) => void;
  onSaveRecording: (rec: SavedRecording) => Promise<void>;
  onGoToLibrary: () => void;
}

function formatSecTimer(ms: number): string {
  const totalSec = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const secs = totalSec % 60;
  const mins = Math.floor(totalSec / 60) % 60;
  const hrs = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
  if (hrs > 0) {
    return `${String(hrs).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  return `${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export const ScreenRecorderView: React.FC<ScreenRecorderViewProps> = ({
  lang,
  capabilities,
  onRecordingStateChange,
  onSaveRecording,
  onGoToLibrary,
}) => {
  const [resolutionId, setResolutionId] = useState<ScreenResolutionId>(
    capabilities?.recommendedResolution || '4k_2160p'
  );
  const [fps, setFps] = useState<60 | 30 | 24>(60);
  const [includeSystemAudio, setIncludeSystemAudio] = useState(true);
  const [includeMicAudio, setIncludeMicAudio] = useState(true);
  const [countdownEnabled, setCountdownEnabled] = useState(false);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'countdown' | 'recording' | 'paused'>('idle');
  const [countdownVal, setCountdownVal] = useState(3);
  const [elapsedMs, setElapsedMs] = useState(0);
  const [negotiatedLabel, setNegotiatedLabel] = useState<string>('');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [savedToast, setSavedToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const previewVideoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const displayStreamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const micStreamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const mixCtxRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);
  const accumMsRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const startAtRef = useRef<number>(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (capabilities && status === 'idle') {
      setResolutionId(capabilities.recommendedResolution);
    }
  }, [capabilities]);

  const stopAllStreams = () => {
    displayStreamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    micStreamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    displayStreamRef.current = null;
    micStreamRef.current = null;
    mixCtxRef.current?.close().catch(() => {});
    mixCtxRef.current = null;
    if (previewVideoRef.current) {
      previewVideoRef.current.srcObject = null;
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => stopAllStreams();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== 'recording') return;
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      setElapsedMs(accumMsRef.current + (performance.now() - startAtRef.current));
    }, 250);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [status]);

  const selectedPreset =
    SCREEN_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === resolutionId) || SCREEN_PRESETS[0];

  const beginCapture = async () => {
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setSavedToast(null);

    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getDisplayMedia) {
      setErrorMsg(
        lang === 'ar'
          ? 'تسجيل الشاشة غير متاح داخل WebView هذا؛ افتح التطبيق في متصفح Chrome/Android لتسجيل الشاشة بدقة تصل إلى 4K.'
          : lang === 'en'
            ? 'Screen capture requires Chrome/browser DisplayMedia support. Open the PWA in Chrome for up to 4K capture.'
            : 'La capture d’écran nécessite Chrome/navigateur compatible DisplayMedia. Ouvrez la PWA dans Chrome pour filmer jusqu’en 4K.'
      );
      setStatus('idle');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const displayStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({
        video: {
          width: { ideal: selectedPreset.width },
          height: { ideal: selectedPreset.height },
          frameRate: { ideal: fps, max: fps },
        },
        audio: includeSystemAudio,
      });
      displayStreamRef.current = displayStream;

      let finalStream: MediaStream = displayStream;
      const videoTrack = displayStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
      const settings = videoTrack?.getSettings();
      const actualW = settings?.width || selectedPreset.width;
      const actualH = settings?.height || selectedPreset.height;
      const actualFps = Math.round(settings?.frameRate || fps);
      setNegotiatedLabel(`${actualW} × ${actualH} · ${actualFps} fps`);

      // Optional Microphone + System Audio mixer
      if (includeMicAudio && navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
        try {
          const micStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
            audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true },
          });
          micStreamRef.current = micStream;

          const AudioCtx =
            window.AudioContext ||
            (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
          if (AudioCtx) {
            const ctx = new AudioCtx();
            mixCtxRef.current = ctx;
            const dest = ctx.createMediaStreamDestination();

            if (displayStream.getAudioTracks().length > 0) {
              ctx.createMediaStreamSource(new MediaStream(displayStream.getAudioTracks())).connect(dest);
            }
            if (micStream.getAudioTracks().length > 0) {
              ctx.createMediaStreamSource(micStream).connect(dest);
            }
            finalStream = new MediaStream([
              ...displayStream.getVideoTracks(),
              ...dest.stream.getAudioTracks(),
            ]);
          }
        } catch {
          // Proceed cleanly without mic if user denied mic permission
        }
      }

      if (previewVideoRef.current) {
        previewVideoRef.current.srcObject = displayStream;
        void previewVideoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
      }

      const mimeType = capabilities?.bestMimeType || 'video/webm';
      const targetBitrate = selectedPreset.bitrateMbps * 1_000_000;
      let recorder: MediaRecorder;
      try {
        recorder = new MediaRecorder(finalStream, {
          mimeType,
          videoBitsPerSecond: targetBitrate,
        });
      } catch {
        recorder = new MediaRecorder(finalStream);
      }

      chunksRef.current = [];
      recorder.ondataavailable = (ev) => {
        if (ev.data && ev.data.size > 0) {
          chunksRef.current.push(ev.data);
        }
      };

      recorder.onstop = async () => {
        const finalDuration =
          accumMsRef.current + (status === 'recording' ? performance.now() - startAtRef.current : 0);
        stopAllStreams();
        onRecordingStateChange(false);
        setStatus('idle');

        const usedMime = recorder.mimeType || mimeType;
        const isMp4 = usedMime.includes('mp4');
        const ext = isMp4 ? 'mp4' : 'webm';
        const videoBlob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type: usedMime });

        if (videoBlob.size > 0) {
          const now = new Date();
          const stamp = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
          const saved: SavedRecording = {
            id: `vid-${Date.now()}`,
            kind: 'video',
            title:
              lang === 'ar'
                ? `تسجيل شاشة ${stamp}`
                : lang === 'en'
                  ? `Screen Capture ${stamp}`
                  : `Capture Écran ${stamp}`,
            formatLabel: `${selectedPreset.shortLabel} · ${ext.toUpperCase()}`,
            fileExt: ext,
            mimeType: usedMime,
            sizeBytes: videoBlob.size,
            durationMs: Math.round(finalDuration),
            createdAt: Date.now(),
            resolutionLabel: `${actualW}×${actualH}`,
            fps: actualFps,
            bitrateLabel: `${selectedPreset.bitrateMbps} Mbps`,
            blob: videoBlob,
          };
          await onSaveRecording(saved);
          setSavedToast(`${saved.title}.${saved.fileExt}`);
        }
        setElapsedMs(0);
      };

      // Handle user stopping share directly from OS/browser bar
      videoTrack.onended = () => {
        if (recorder.state !== 'inactive') {
          recorder.stop();
        }
      };

      mediaRecorderRef.current = recorder;
      recorder.start(500);
      accumMsRef.current = 0;
      startAtRef.current = performance.now();
      setElapsedMs(0);
      setStatus('recording');
      onRecordingStateChange(true);
    } catch {
      stopAllStreams();
      setStatus('idle');
      setErrorMsg(
        lang === 'ar'
          ? 'تم إلغاء إذن تصوير الشاشة.'
          : lang === 'en'
            ? 'Screen capture permission canceled or unsupported.'
            : 'Capture d’écran annulée ou non autorisée.'
      );
    }
  };

  const handleStartClick = () => {
    if (!countdownEnabled) {
      void beginCapture();
      return;
    }
    setStatus('countdown');
    setCountdownVal(3);
    let current = 3;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      current -= 1;
      if (current <= 0) {
        clearInterval(timer);
        void beginCapture();
      } else {
        setCountdownVal(current);
      }
    }, 1000);
  };

  const handlePauseResume = () => {
    const rec = mediaRecorderRef.current;
    if (!rec) return;
    if (status === 'recording') {
      accumMsRef.current += performance.now() - startAtRef.current;
      rec.pause();
      setStatus('paused');
    } else if (status === 'paused') {
      startAtRef.current = performance.now();
      rec.resume();
      setStatus('recording');
    }
  };

  const handleStop = () => {
    const rec = mediaRecorderRef.current;
    if (rec && rec.state !== 'inactive') {
      rec.stop();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-4 max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full space-y-5">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 items-start">
        {/* Left: Live Screen Capture Stage */}
        <section className="lg:col-span-7 rounded-3xl border border-[#2a2416] bg-gradient-to-b from-[#17140d] to-[#0d0d0d] p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#d4af37]">
              <Monitor className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{selectedPreset.label}</span>
              <span className="text-stone-500">·</span>
              <span className="font-mono">{fps} fps</span>
            </div>

            {status === 'recording' && (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-rose-400">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 animate-pulse" />
                {formatSecTimer(elapsedMs)}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Monitor Mirror Viewport */}
          <div className="relative aspect-video w-full rounded-2xl bg-[#070707] border border-[#262218] overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center">
            <video
              ref={previewVideoRef}
              muted
              playsInline
              className={`w-full h-full object-contain ${status === 'recording' || status === 'paused' ? 'block' : 'hidden'}`}
            />

            {status === 'idle' && (
              <div className="text-center p-6 space-y-2">
                <Video className="w-10 h-10 text-[#d4af37]/70 mx-auto" />
                <p className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-white">
                  {selectedPreset.shortLabel} · {selectedPreset.bitrateMbps} Mbps
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-400">
                  {capabilities
                    ? `${lang === 'ar' ? 'شاشة الهاتف المكتشفة' : lang === 'en' ? 'Detected Display' : 'Écran détecté'}: ${capabilities.physicalLongEdge}×${capabilities.physicalShortEdge}px`
                    : '...'}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            {status === 'countdown' && (
              <div className="text-center space-y-2">
                <p className="font-mono font-black text-7xl text-[#d4af37] tabular-nums">{countdownVal}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-stone-300">
                  {lang === 'ar' ? 'استعد للتسجيل...' : lang === 'en' ? 'Preparing capture...' : 'Préparation...'}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            {negotiatedLabel && (status === 'recording' || status === 'paused') && (
              <div className="absolute bottom-2.5 left-2.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-black/75 border border-[#d4af37]/40 text-[11px] font-mono text-[#f3e5ab]">
                {negotiatedLabel}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {errorMsg && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/35 text-xs text-rose-300 leading-relaxed">
              {errorMsg}
            </div>
          )}

          {savedToast && status === 'idle' && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#18160d] border border-[#d4af37]/40 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#f3e5ab] truncate">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37] shrink-0" />
                <span className="truncate">{savedToast}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onGoToLibrary}
                className="font-bold text-[#d4af37] hover:underline shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {lang === 'ar' ? 'فتح المكتبة' : lang === 'en' ? 'Open Vault' : 'Ouvrir'}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Action Buttons */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {status === 'idle' || status === 'countdown' ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={status === 'countdown'}
                onClick={handleStartClick}
                className="w-full min-h-[56px] rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#d4af37] to-[#aa8010] hover:from-[#e5c158] hover:to-[#be9012] disabled:opacity-50 text-stone-950 text-base font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Video className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span>
                  {lang === 'ar'
                    ? `بدء تصوير الشاشة (${selectedPreset.shortLabel})`
                    : lang === 'en'
                      ? `Record Screen (${selectedPreset.shortLabel})`
                      : `Filmer l’Écran (${selectedPreset.shortLabel})`}
                </span>
              </button>
            ) : (
              <>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handlePauseResume}
                  className="flex-1 min-h-[54px] rounded-2xl bg-[#1a1a1a] hover:bg-[#252525] border border-[#303030] text-white text-sm font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {status === 'paused' ? <Play className="w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37]" /> : <Pause className="w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37]" />}
                  <span>
                    {status === 'paused'
                      ? lang === 'ar' ? 'استمرار' : lang === 'en' ? 'Resume' : 'Reprendre'
                      : lang === 'ar' ? 'إيقاف مؤقت' : lang === 'en' ? 'Pause' : 'Pause'}
                  </span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleStop}
                  className="flex-1 min-h-[54px] rounded-2xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white text-sm font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Square className="w-4 h-4 fill-current" />
                  <span>{lang === 'ar' ? 'إيقاف وحفظ' : lang === 'en' ? 'Stop & Save' : 'Arrêter & Sauver'}</span>
                </button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Right: Adaptive Resolution Up to 4K & Codec Settings */}
        <section className="lg:col-span-5 rounded-3xl border border-[#242424] bg-[#121212] p-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37]" />
              <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-white">
                {lang === 'ar' ? 'الدقة حسب قدرات الهاتف' : lang === 'en' ? 'Adaptive Resolution (Up to 4K)' : 'Résolution Adaptative (jusqu’à 4K)'}
              </h2>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            {SCREEN_PRESETS.map((preset) => {
              const tier = capabilities?.tiers[preset.id];
              const active = resolutionId === preset.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={preset.id}
                  type="button"
                  disabled={status !== 'idle'}
                  onClick={() => setResolutionId(preset.id)}
                  className={`w-full min-h-[54px] px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl border flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-60 ${
                    active
                      ? 'bg-[#1a160c] border-[#d4af37] text-white'
                      : 'bg-[#161616] border-[#252525] text-stone-300 hover:border-[#383838]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className={`text-sm font-bold truncate ${active ? 'text-[#d4af37]' : 'text-white'}`}>
                      {preset.label}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-400 truncate">
                      {tier ? tier.reason[lang] : `${preset.bitrateMbps} Mbps`}
                      {tier?.recommended ? ` · ${lang === 'ar' ? 'موصى به' : lang === 'en' ? 'Recommended' : 'Recommandé'}` : ''}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono text-stone-400 shrink-0 tabular-nums">
                    {preset.bitrateMbps} Mbps
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* FPS Selector */}
          <div className="space-y-2 pt-1">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-300">
              {lang === 'ar' ? 'معدل الإطارات' : lang === 'en' ? 'Frame Rate' : 'Fluidité (FPS)'}

            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={status !== 'idle'}
              onClick={() => setIncludeSystemAudio((v) => !v)}

                  : 'bg-[#161616] border-[#262626] text-stone-400'

===== FILE: recorder/src/components/LibraryView.tsx =====
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Download,
  FileAudio,
  Film,
  Pause,
  Play,
  RefreshCw,
  Trash2,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { AppLang, AudioFormatId, SavedRecording } from '../types';
import { AUDIO_FORMAT_PRESETS, encodeAudioBlobToPreset } from '../utils/audioEncoder';

interface LibraryViewProps {
  lang: AppLang;
  recordings: SavedRecording[];
  onDelete: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  onSaveConverted: (rec: SavedRecording) => Promise<void>;
}

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB`;
}

function formatDuration(ms: number): string {
  const totalSec = Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 1000));
  const m = Math.floor(totalSec / 60);
  const s = totalSec % 60;
  return `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export const LibraryView: React.FC<LibraryViewProps> = ({
  lang,
  recordings,
  onDelete,
  onSaveConverted,
}) => {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'audio' | 'video'>('all');
  const [playingId, setPlayingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [videoModalRec, setVideoModalRec] = useState<{ rec: SavedRecording; url: string } | null>(null);
  const [convertingId, setConvertingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const audioElRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
  const audioUrlRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      audioElRef.current?.pause();
      if (audioUrlRef.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(audioUrlRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const filtered = recordings.filter((r) => (filter === 'all' ? true : r.kind === filter));

  const togglePlayAudio = (rec: SavedRecording) => {
    if (playingId === rec.id && audioElRef.current) {
      audioElRef.current.pause();
      setPlayingId(null);
      return;
    }

    audioElRef.current?.pause();
    if (audioUrlRef.current) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(audioUrlRef.current);
    }

    const url = URL.createObjectURL(rec.blob);
    audioUrlRef.current = url;
    const audio = new Audio(url);
    audioElRef.current = audio;
    audio.onended = () => setPlayingId(null);
    void audio.play();
    setPlayingId(rec.id);
  };

  const handleDownload = (rec: SavedRecording) => {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(rec.blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    const safeName = rec.title.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\u0600-\u06FF_-]+/g, '_');
    a.download = `${safeName}.${rec.fileExt}`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
  };

  const handleReencode = async (rec: SavedRecording, targetFormatId: AudioFormatId) => {
    const preset = AUDIO_FORMAT_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === targetFormatId);
    if (!preset) return;
    setConvertingId(rec.id);
    try {
      const { blob, durationMs, peaks } = await encodeAudioBlobToPreset(rec.blob, preset);
      const converted: SavedRecording = {
        ...rec,
        id: `aud-${Date.now()}`,
        title: `${rec.title} (${preset.kbps}k)`,
        formatLabel: preset.title,
        fileExt: preset.ext,
        mimeType: preset.mimeType,
        sizeBytes: blob.size,
        durationMs: durationMs || rec.durationMs,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        bitrateLabel: `${preset.kbps} kbps`,
        peaks,
        blob,
      };
      await onSaveConverted(converted);
    } finally {
      setConvertingId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-4 max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full space-y-4">
      {/* Filter Segment */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 rounded-2xl bg-[#121212] border border-[#242424]">
          {(['all', 'audio', 'video'] as const).map((key) => (
            <button
              key={key}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilter(key)}
              className={`min-h-[38px] px-3.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                filter === key ? 'bg-[#d4af37] text-stone-950' : 'text-stone-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              {key === 'all'
                ? lang === 'ar' ? 'الكل' : lang === 'en' ? 'All' : 'Tout'
                : key === 'audio'
                  ? lang === 'ar' ? 'صوت MP3' : lang === 'en' ? 'Audio' : 'Audio'
                  : lang === 'ar' ? 'فيديو الشاشة' : lang === 'en' ? 'Screen Video' : 'Vidéo Écran'}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <span className="text-xs text-stone-400 font-mono">
          {filtered.length} {lang === 'ar' ? 'ملفات' : lang === 'en' ? 'files' : 'fichiers'}
        </span>
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-12 rounded-3xl border border-[#242424] bg-[#121212] text-center space-y-3">
          <FileAudio className="w-10 h-10 text-[#d4af37]/50 mx-auto" />
          <p className="text-sm text-stone-400">
            {lang === 'ar'
              ? 'لا توجد تسجيلات محفوظة بعد.'
              : lang === 'en'
                ? 'No saved audio or screen recordings yet.'
                : 'Aucun enregistrement audio ou vidéo pour le moment.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3.5">
          {filtered.map((rec) => {
            const isPlaying = playingId === rec.id;
            const dateStr = new Date(rec.createdAt).toLocaleString(
              lang === 'ar' ? 'ar-TN' : lang === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'fr-FR',
              { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }
            );

            return (
              <div
                key={rec.id}
                className="rounded-3xl border border-[#242424] bg-[#121212] p-4 space-y-3 flex flex-col justify-between"
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (rec.kind === 'audio') {
                          togglePlayAudio(rec);
                        } else {
                          const url = URL.createObjectURL(rec.blob);
                          setVideoModalRec({ rec, url });
                        }
                      }}
                      className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-[#1a160c] border border-[#d4af37]/50 text-[#d4af37] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#d4af37] hover:text-stone-950 transition-colors"
                    >
                      {rec.kind === 'audio' ? (
                        isPlaying ? <Pause className="w-5 h-5 fill-current" /> : <Play className="w-5 h-5 fill-current" />
                      ) : (
                        <Film className="w-5 h-5" />
                      )}
                    </button>

                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="font-bold text-sm text-white truncate">{rec.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-stone-400 truncate">
                        <span className="text-[#d4af37] font-semibold">{rec.formatLabel}</span>
                        {' · '}
                        {formatDuration(rec.durationMs)}
                        {' · '}
                        {formatBytes(rec.sizeBytes)}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-500">
                        {dateStr}
                        {rec.resolutionLabel ? ` · ${rec.resolutionLabel}` : ''}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleDownload(rec)}
                      aria-label="Download"
                      className="min-w-[40px] min-h-[40px] rounded-xl bg-[#181818] hover:bg-[#d4af37] text-stone-300 hover:text-stone-950 border border-[#2a2a2a] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                    >
                      <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onDelete(rec.id)}
                      aria-label="Delete"
                      className="min-w-[40px] min-h-[40px] rounded-xl bg-[#181818] hover:bg-red-500/15 text-stone-400 hover:text-red-400 border border-[#2a2a2a] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Audio Waveform Peaks + Multi-MP3 Converter */}
                {rec.kind === 'audio' && (
                  <div className="space-y-2.5">
                    {rec.peaks && rec.peaks.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="h-8 flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1">
                        {rec.peaks.map((p, idx) => (
                          <div
                            key={idx}
                            className={`flex-1 rounded-full ${isPlaying ? 'bg-[#d4af37]' : 'bg-[#d4af37]/45'}`}
                            style={{ height: `${Math.round(p * 100)}%` }}
                          />
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-[#202020] text-[11px]">
                      <span className="text-stone-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <RefreshCw className={`w-3 h-3 text-[#d4af37] ${convertingId === rec.id ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                        {lang === 'ar' ? 'تحويل الصيغة:' : lang === 'en' ? 'Convert MP3:' : 'Convertir :'}
                      </span>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap">
                        {AUDIO_FORMAT_PRESETS.filter((p) => p.title !== rec.formatLabel).map((preset) => (
                          <button
                            key={preset.id}
                            type="button"
                            disabled={convertingId === rec.id}
                            onClick={() => handleReencode(rec, preset.id)}
                            className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#181818] hover:bg-[#d4af37] hover:text-stone-950 border border-[#2a2a2a] font-mono text-[10px] font-bold text-stone-300 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
                          >
                            {preset.ext === 'wav' ? 'WAV' : `${preset.kbps}k`}
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Video Playback Modal */}
      {videoModalRec && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/90 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
          onClick={() => {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(videoModalRec.url);
            setVideoModalRec(null);
          }}
        >
          <div
            className="w-full max-w-3xl rounded-3xl border border-[#333333] bg-[#121212] p-4 space-y-3 shadow-2xl"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-white">{videoModalRec.rec.title}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#d4af37]">{videoModalRec.rec.formatLabel}</p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  URL.revokeObjectURL(videoModalRec.url);
                  setVideoModalRec(null);
                }}
                className="min-w-[40px] min-h-[40px] rounded-xl hover:bg-[#222222] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <video src={videoModalRec.url} controls autoPlay className="w-full max-h-[70vh] rounded-2xl bg-black" />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

function floatToInt16(floatSamples: Float32Array): Int16Array {
  const out = new Int16Array(floatSamples.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < floatSamples.length; i++) {
    const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, floatSamples[i]));
    out[i] = s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7fff;
  }
  return out;
}

async function resampleAudioBuffer(
  buffer: AudioBuffer,
  targetChannels: 1 | 2,
  targetSampleRate: number
): Promise<AudioBuffer> {
  if (buffer.sampleRate === targetSampleRate && buffer.numberOfChannels === targetChannels) {
    return buffer;
  }
  const targetLength = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(buffer.duration * targetSampleRate));
  const offline = new OfflineAudioContext(targetChannels, targetLength, targetSampleRate);
  const src = offline.createBufferSource();
  src.buffer = buffer;
  src.connect(offline.destination);
  src.start(0);
  return await offline.startRendering();
}

function encodeWavBlob(buffer: AudioBuffer): Blob {
  const numChannels = buffer.numberOfChannels;
  const sampleRate = buffer.sampleRate;
  const length = buffer.length;
  const bytesPerSample = 2;
  const blockAlign = numChannels * bytesPerSample;
  const dataByteLength = length * blockAlign;
  const arrayBuffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + dataByteLength);
  const view = new DataView(arrayBuffer);

  const writeStr = (offset: number, str: string) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
      view.setUint8(offset + i, str.charCodeAt(i));
    }
  };

  writeStr(0, 'RIFF');
  view.setUint32(4, 36 + dataByteLength, true);
  writeStr(8, 'WAVE');
  writeStr(12, 'fmt ');
  view.setUint32(16, 16, true);
  view.setUint16(20, 1, true);
  view.setUint16(22, numChannels, true);
  view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true);
  view.setUint32(28, sampleRate * blockAlign, true);
  view.setUint16(32, blockAlign, true);
  view.setUint16(34, 16, true);
  writeStr(36, 'data');
  view.setUint32(40, dataByteLength, true);

  const channels: Float32Array[] = [];
  for (let ch = 0; ch < numChannels; ch++) {
    channels.push(buffer.getChannelData(ch));
  }

  let offset = 44;
  for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    for (let ch = 0; ch < numChannels; ch++) {
      const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, channels[ch][i]));
      view.setInt16(offset, s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7fff, true);
      offset += 2;
    }
  }

  return new Blob([arrayBuffer], { type: 'audio/wav' });
}

export async function encodeAudioBlobToPreset(
  rawBlob: Blob,
  preset: AudioFormatPreset,
  onProgress?: (pct: number) => void
): Promise<{ blob: Blob; durationMs: number; peaks: number[] }> {
  const AudioCtx =
    window.AudioContext ||
    (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
  if (!AudioCtx) {
    throw new Error('Web Audio API unavailable');
  }

  const ctx = new AudioCtx();
  try {
    const arrayBuffer = await rawBlob.arrayBuffer();
    const decoded = await ctx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);
    const durationMs = Math.round(decoded.duration * 1000);

    // Extract 48 normalized visual waveform peaks for library card display
    const ch0 = decoded.getChannelData(0);
    const peakCount = 44;
    const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ch0.length / peakCount));
    const peaks: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < peakCount; i++) {
      let maxAbs = 0;
      const start = i * step;
      const end = Math.min(ch0.length, start + step);
      for (let j = start; j < end; j += Math.max(1, Math.floor(step / 16))) {
        const v = Math.abs(ch0[j]);
        if (v > maxAbs) maxAbs = v;
      }
      peaks.push(Math.min(1, Math.max(0.08, maxAbs)));
    }

    onProgress?.(20);
    const resampled = await resampleAudioBuffer(decoded, preset.channels, preset.sampleRate);
    onProgress?.(40);

    if (preset.ext === 'wav') {
      const wavBlob = encodeWavBlob(resampled);
      onProgress?.(100);
      return { blob: wavBlob, durationMs, peaks };
    }

    const mp3encoder = new Mp3Encoder(preset.channels, preset.sampleRate, preset.kbps);
    const leftInt16 = floatToInt16(resampled.getChannelData(0));
    const rightInt16 =
      preset.channels === 2 ? floatToInt16(resampled.getChannelData(1)) : undefined;

    const sampleBlockSize = 1152;
    const mp3Chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
    const totalSamples = leftInt16.length;

    for (let i = 0; i < totalSamples; i += sampleBlockSize) {
      const leftChunk = leftInt16.subarray(i, i + sampleBlockSize);
      const rightChunk = rightInt16 ? rightInt16.subarray(i, i + sampleBlockSize) : undefined;
      const mp3buf = mp3encoder.encodeBuffer(leftChunk, rightChunk);
      if (mp3buf.length > 0) {
        mp3Chunks.push(new Uint8Array(mp3buf));
      }
      if (i % (sampleBlockSize * 32) === 0) {
        onProgress?.(40 + Math.round((i / totalSamples) * 55));
      }
    }

    const endBuf = mp3encoder.flush();
    if (endBuf.length > 0) {
      mp3Chunks.push(new Uint8Array(endBuf));
    }

    onProgress?.(100);
    const blobParts = mp3Chunks.map((c) => {
      const copy = new Uint8Array(c.byteLength);
      copy.set(c);
      return copy.buffer;
    });
    return {
      blob: new Blob(blobParts, { type: 'audio/mpeg' }),
      durationMs,
      peaks,
    };
  } finally {
    await ctx.close().catch(() => {});
  }
}

async function probeHardwareEncoder4K(): Promise<{ uhd4k: boolean; qhd2k: boolean }> {
  const VideoEnc = (window as unknown as { VideoEncoder?: { isConfigSupported: (c: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<{ supported: boolean }> } }).VideoEncoder;
  if (!VideoEnc?.isConfigSupported) {
    return { uhd4k: false, qhd2k: true };
  }

  try {
    const [res4kAvc, res4kVp9, res2k] = await Promise.all([
      VideoEnc.isConfigSupported({
        codec: 'avc1.640033',
        width: 3840,
        height: 2160,
        bitrate: 32_000_000,
        framerate: 30,
      }).catch(() => ({ supported: false })),
      VideoEnc.isConfigSupported({
        codec: 'vp09.00.51.08',
        width: 3840,
        height: 2160,
        bitrate: 32_000_000,
        framerate: 30,
      }).catch(() => ({ supported: false })),
      VideoEnc.isConfigSupported({
        codec: 'avc1.4d002a',
        width: 2560,
        height: 1440,
        bitrate: 18_000_000,
        framerate: 60,
      }).catch(() => ({ supported: false })),
    ]);

    return {
      uhd4k: Boolean(res4kAvc.supported || res4kVp9.supported),
      qhd2k: Boolean(res2k.supported),
    };
  } catch {
    return { uhd4k: false, qhd2k: true };
  }
}

export async function detectDeviceCapabilities(): Promise<DeviceCapabilities> {
  const dpr = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.devicePixelRatio || 1 : 1;
  const rawW = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? Math.round(window.screen.width * dpr) : 1920;
  const rawH = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? Math.round(window.screen.height * dpr) : 1080;
  const physicalLongEdge = Math.max(rawW, rawH);
  const physicalShortEdge = Math.min(rawW, rawH);

  const supportsDisplayCapture =
    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
    Boolean(navigator.mediaDevices && typeof navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia === 'function');

  const supportsAudioCapture =
    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
    Boolean(navigator.mediaDevices && typeof navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia === 'function');

  const supportedMimeTypes =
    typeof MediaRecorder !== 'undefined'
      ? CANDIDATE_VIDEO_MIMES.filter((m) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m))
      : [];

  const bestMimeType = supportedMimeTypes[0] || 'video/webm';
  const supportsWebCodecs = typeof (window as unknown as { VideoEncoder?: unknown }).VideoEncoder !== 'undefined';

  const hw = await probeHardwareEncoder4K();
  const cores = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4 : 4;
  const capable4K = hw.uhd4k || (physicalLongEdge >= 2800 && cores >= 6);
  const capable2K = hw.qhd2k || physicalLongEdge >= 2000 || cores >= 4;

  const recommendedResolution: ScreenResolutionId = capable4K
    ? '4k_2160p'
    : capable2K
      ? '2k_1440p'
      : 'fhd_1080p';

  const tiers: Record<ScreenResolutionId, ScreenTierSupport> = {
    '4k_2160p': {
      id: '4k_2160p',
      capable: capable4K,
      recommended: recommendedResolution === '4k_2160p',
      reason: capable4K
        ? {
            fr: 'Encodeur matériel 4K prêt',
            ar: 'معالج 4K مدعوم على جهازك',
            en: 'Hardware 4K encoder ready',
          }
        : {
            fr: 'Mise à l’échelle adaptative depuis l’écran',
            ar: 'ضبط تلقائي حسب دقة الشاشة',
            en: 'Adaptive scaling to display ceiling',
          },
    },
    '2k_1440p': {
      id: '2k_1440p',
      capable: capable2K,
      recommended: recommendedResolution === '2k_1440p',
      reason: {
        fr: 'Netteté QHD fluide',
        ar: 'دقة QHD سلسة',
        en: 'Crisp QHD smoothness',
      },
    },
    fhd_1080p: {
      id: 'fhd_1080p',
      capable: true,
      recommended: recommendedResolution === 'fhd_1080p',
      reason: {
        fr: 'Standard universel 60 fps',
        ar: 'قياسي عالمي 60 إطار',
        en: 'Universal 60 fps standard',
      },
    },
    hd_720p: {
      id: 'hd_720p',
      capable: true,
      recommended: false,
      reason: {
        fr: 'Fichiers compacts',
        ar: 'حجم ملف أصغر',
        en: 'Compact file size',
      },
    },
  };

  return {
    physicalLongEdge,
    physicalShortEdge,
    devicePixelRatio: Number(dpr.toFixed(2)),
    supportsDisplayCapture,
    supportsAudioCapture,
    supportsWebCodecs,
    supportedMimeTypes,
    bestMimeType,
    tiers,
    recommendedResolution,
  };
}

===== FILE: recorder/src/utils/mediaDb.ts =====
import { SavedRecording } from '../types';

const DB_NAME = 'studio_rec_media_vault_v1';
const STORE_NAME = 'recordings';
const DB_VERSION = 1;

function openDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      const db = req.result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
    };
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

export async function getAllRecordings(): Promise<SavedRecording[]> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const req = store.getAll();
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const items = (req.result as SavedRecording[]) || [];
      items.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
      resolve(items);
    };
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

export async function saveRecordingItem(item: SavedRecording): Promise<void> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    store.put(item);
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

export async function deleteRecordingItem(id: string): Promise<void> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    store.delete(id);
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

// If the loader is already loaded, just stop.
if (!self.define) {
  let registry = {};

  // Used for `eval` and `importScripts` where we can't get script URL by other means.
  // In both cases, it's safe to use a global var because those functions are synchronous.
  let nextDefineUri;

  const singleRequire = (uri, parentUri) => {
    uri = new URL(uri + ".js", parentUri).href;
    return registry[uri] || (
      
        new Promise(resolve => {
          if ("document" in self) {
            const script = document.createElement("script");
            script.src = uri;
            script.onload = resolve;
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          } else {
            nextDefineUri = uri;
            importScripts(uri);
            resolve();
          }
        })
      
      .then(() => {
        let promise = registry[uri];
        if (!promise) {
          throw new Error(`Module ${uri} didn’t register its module`);
        }
        return promise;
      })
    );
  };

  self.define = (depsNames, factory) => {
    const uri = nextDefineUri || ("document" in self ? document.currentScript.src : "") || location.href;
    if (registry[uri]) {
      // Module is already loading or loaded.
      return;
    }
    let exports = {};
    const require = depUri => singleRequire(depUri, uri);
    const specialDeps = {
      module: { uri },
      exports,
      require
    };
    registry[uri] = Promise.all(depsNames.map(
      depName => specialDeps[depName] || require(depName)
    )).then(deps => {
      factory(...deps);
      return exports;
    });
  };
}

     * Claim any currently available clients once the service worker
     * becomes active. This is normally used in conjunction with `skipWaiting()`.
     *
     * @memberof workbox-core
     */
    function clientsClaim() {
      self.addEventListener('activate', () => self.clients.claim());
    }

    /*
      Copyright 2019 Google LLC
      Use of this source code is governed by an MIT-style
      license that can be found in the LICENSE file or at
      https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT.
    */
    const logger = (() => {
      // Don't overwrite this value if it's already set.
      // See https://github.com/GoogleChrome/workbox/pull/2284#issuecomment-560470923
      if (!('__WB_DISABLE_DEV_LOGS' in globalThis)) {
        self.__WB_DISABLE_DEV_LOGS = false;
      }
      let inGroup = false;
      const methodToColorMap = {
        debug: `#7f8c8d`,
        log: `#2ecc71`,
        warn: `#f39c12`,
        error: `#c0392b`,
        groupCollapsed: `#3498db`,
        groupEnd: null // No colored prefix on groupEnd
      };
      const print = function (method, args) {
        if (self.__WB_DISABLE_DEV_LOGS) {
          return;
        }
        if (method === 'groupCollapsed') {
          // Safari doesn't print all console.groupCollapsed() arguments:
          // https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=182754
          if (/^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(navigator.userAgent)) {
            console[method](...args);
            return;
          }
        }
        const styles = [`background: ${methodToColorMap[method]}`, `border-radius: 0.5em`, `color: white`, `font-weight: bold`, `padding: 2px 0.5em`];
        // When in a group, the workbox prefix is not displayed.
        const logPrefix = inGroup ? [] : ['%cworkbox', styles.join(';')];
        console[method](...logPrefix, ...args);
        if (method === 'groupCollapsed') {
          inGroup = true;
        }
        if (method === 'groupEnd') {
          inGroup = false;
        }
      };
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-types
      const api = {};
      const loggerMethods = Object.keys(methodToColorMap);
      for (const key of loggerMethods) {
        const method = key;
        api[method] = (...args) => {
          print(method, args);
        };
      }
      return api;
    })();
